verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official MCP server (mcp-v2) that Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and Codex can connect to via OAuth. Its documented tools fetch unaddressed PR comments, read the repository knowledge base, and view, search, and create coding patterns, with auto-fix workflows built on top. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server's reliability and a full tool reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Codex to Greptile MCP with OAuth.
Fetch PR comments - Get unaddressed Greptile feedback for any PR
Read the knowledge base - Get Greptile's synthesized documentation for an enrolled repository
With MCP, you can view, search, and create patterns from your IDE.
